+  /* #304 W3a — ds-005's truncating-label form, WHOLE: `text-box-edge:text text` only acts on a box
+     that is trimmed, and the scaffold's element list does not hold <p>, so the label computed
+     text-box-trim:none, a 14px line-height:1 box under an 18px text box, and overflow:hidden cut
+     2px of every descender (R4s (f); R4b G8, 12 labels at 1440). trim-both makes the edge bite:
+     the box becomes the full text box and the ellipsis survives (#261 N4, the same repair). */
   .kpi-lbl{margin:0; opacity:var(--alpha-60); min-width:0; overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap;
-    text-overflow:ellipsis; text-box-edge:text text;}
